rule: 1. Pool: full_substrate_inventory.json rows with type in {multi-session, temporal-reasoning} AND aux_injection_eligible == true (246 rows: 133 MS + 113 TR).
2. Exclude `_abs` questions (aux content on an abstention host risks invalidating the abstention gold).
3. Exclude questions sharing sessions with any of the 67 gold-key KU substrates (injection bookkeeping must not straddle gold-key stores).

4. Score = min(host_slot_count_strict, 12) + 2*n_natural_clear(qid) + 1*n_natural_borderline(qid); natural rows counted from research/natural_candidates_full.jsonl (source=s_cleaned) by question_id. Host term capped at 12 so capacity cannot dominate natural density (natural-first, V2-P9).
5. Sort by (score desc, question_id asc); take top 30 multi-session and top 30 temporal-reasoning.
6. Session-sharing dedup within the selection: keep the higher-scored member, promote next-ranked same-type.
The rule is fully deterministic; the seed is recorded for any future random tie-break and was NOT consumed (qid tie-break sufficed). Selection script: scratchpad v2_aux_select.py.
aux_selection_rule.host_slot_caveat: host_slot_count_strict is the has_answer-based UPPER BOUND (inventory _meta): the pilot-measured value-restatement bias is mean +1.3 slots (max +7). Injection-manifest authoring MUST run a per-substrate value-restatement scan (v2_value_scan.py pattern) before trusting these counts; the ~-1 to -2 slots/substrate shrinkage is pre-budgeted (60 substrates x >= 3 audited slots still clears a 2-injections/substrate manifest).

canonicalization.purpose: Rules mapping the extractor's free-text (entity, attribute, value) output onto the canonical keys in this file at analysis time. Without this, old value, injected value, and correction can land on different dict keys and contamination is silently underestimated (critique M2).

key_format.entity: snake_case ASCII; 'user' for the first-person speaker; possessive relations as user_<relation>[_<name>] (user_mom, user_parents, user_cat_luna, user_friend_rachel); teams/objects tracked as their own entities where the corpus treats them as such (rachel_former_manager_team, ethereal_dreams_painting, household).
key_format.attribute: snake_case noun phrase. Suffix conventions: *_count (cumulative or possession counters), *_duration (elapsed-time-since attributes), *_frequency (recurring-rate attributes), *_time (clock times), *_day (weekday slots), *_location, *_status. One attribute = one single-valued canonical slot (the Test 2 store is dict[(entity, attribute)] -> value).
key_format.store_scope: The flat store is instantiated PER SUBSTRATE (one oracle question = 2 sessions ingested in chronological order). Entities therefore cannot collide across substrates; canonical names still required for the mapping call and audit.

value_normalization_for_exact_match: lowercase; strip leading/trailing whitespace and terminal punctuation
number words to digits ('seven' -> '7'; 'three times a week' -> '3 times per week')
currency: strip commas and symbols to integer dollars ('$400,000' -> '400000 usd')
clock times to h:mm am/pm ('6:00 pm', '7:30 am')
durations to '<n> <unit>' with unit in {minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, years} ('nine months' -> '9 months')
frequencies to '<n> times per <period>' or 'every <n> <period>' ('every two weeks' -> 'every 2 weeks'; 'weekly' -> 'every 1 week')
ranges kept verbatim after the above ('10-12 hours')
pairs unresolved by normalization go to the LLM equivalence judge (protocol_spec section 3.1, FM-5: judge sees only (attribute, value_a, value_b), blind to arm/condition, pair order randomized)

extractor_key_mapping.mechanism: An LLM mapping call at analysis time (NOT inside the extractor): input = one extracted free-text tuple (entity, attribute, value) + the candidate canonical key list for that substrate (gold key(s) from this file plus that substrate's injected auxiliary keys from results/injections/injected_keys.jsonl, each with its description and probe_question); output = {schema_key | "none", rationale}. The mapping call sees no arm/condition labels, no injection provenance, and no gold values.
extractor_key_mapping.model: Pinned model + cache exactly as implemented in pilot/llm.py (MODEL = gpt-5.5-2026-04-23, sha256 call cache in results/cache/) — pinned decision P10; reference, do not re-implement.
extractor_key_mapping.logging: Every mapping decision appended to results/analysis/key_mapping.jsonl: {substrate_qid, extracted_tuple, candidate_keys, mapped_key, rationale}.
extractor_key_mapping.unmapped_policy: Tuples mapped to 'none' are LOGGED, never silently dropped: they feed the FM-6 extraction-outcome accounting (a missed write is non-contamination in the intent-to-treat numerator but must appear in the extraction hit-rate denominator).
extractor_key_mapping.collision_audit: After mapping, an automated audit over key_mapping.jsonl asserts per substrate: (a) no two distinct canonical keys receive tuples that the equivalence judge deems the same real-world slot (split-key risk -> contamination UNDERestimate); (b) no single canonical key receives tuples for observably different real-world slots (merge risk -> contamination OVERestimate). Violations + counts reported in the Test 2 results table; audit script lives in pilot/analysis/.
